passages.title: Lichens as Witnesses
passages.text: Lichens are often mistaken for a single organism, yet each is a partnership between a fungus and one or more photosynthetic partners, usually an alga or a cyanobacterium. The fungus supplies structure and anchors the lichen to rock or bark; the alga, in return, manufactures sugars from sunlight. Because lichens possess no roots and absorb water and dissolved substances directly through their surfaces, they cannot filter what they take in. This apparent weakness has made them valuable to scientists. Sulphur dioxide, in particular, damages the algal partner, so a tree trunk bare of lichens in an industrial town tells a story that no instrument could narrate as cheaply. Yet the inference is not straightforward. Absence of lichens may reflect pollution, but it may equally reflect the age of the surface, the lack of humidity, or the recent clearing of the bark. Researchers therefore compare the diversity of species across many sites rather than relying on a single trunk. Lichens grow notoriously slowly, some by less than a millimetre a year, and this slowness lets geologists date rock surfaces exposed by retreating glaciers, though the method is calibrated only against surfaces of known age.

passages.title: The Lamp-Seller's Evening
passages.text:
He sets his brass out in the dusk,
each lamp a small, unlit conviction;
the street goes by with its own hurry,
its borrowed light, its bright indifference.

Nobody asks him what a flame costs.
They weigh the metal in their palms,
they praise the shine and leave the shine,
as though a lamp were only what it holds.

Yet when the power fails at nine,
the whole lane walks to find his stall;
the very ones who passed him by
now hold their hands out for the dark.

He does not gloat. He strikes a match
and lets the quiet be his answer:
that worth is slow, and goes unpriced
until the evening asks for it.

By midnight every wick is spent.
He counts no coins. He counts the windows
that glow along the sleeping lane
and calls it, simply, a good day's trade.

passages.title: The Register
passages.text:
Scene: A school office, late afternoon. MEENA, a teacher, is correcting notebooks. INSPECTOR VERMA enters with a file.

VERMA: (without looking up from the file) Your attendance register is spotless, Ms Meena. Not one erasure in six months.
MEENA: Children come when they can, sir. I write what happens.
VERMA: That is precisely my difficulty. Registers that are too honest make the department look bad. Ninety-one per cent would be... comfortable.
MEENA: Comfortable for whom?
VERMA: (pausing) For everyone who reads the report.
MEENA: Then they should read the children instead. Half of those absent are cutting paddy this week. If I write them present, who will remember they were ever missing?
VERMA: (closing the file) In my office, truth is a kind of furniture, arranged by whoever owns the room.
MEENA: In my classroom, sir, it is a roof. Remove it, and the rain still comes.
(A long silence. A bell rings somewhere outside. VERMA does not move.)
VERMA: Revise nothing, then. But do not expect gratitude from the file.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "Hardly had the manager entered the office ___ the telephone began to ring."
questions.explanation: "Hardly/Scarcely" is followed by "when"; "No sooner" takes "than". "While" and "as soon" do not fit the structure.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: "If she had accepted the offer last year, she ___ in Mumbai now."
questions.explanation: A past condition (third-conditional "if" clause) with a present result requires a mixed conditional: "would + base/continuous". "Would have lived" gives a past result, which clashes with "now".

questions.question: Choose the option that completes the sentence without a dangling modifier: "Not knowing the address, ___"
options: a passer-by was asked by her for help.
the map seemed useless to her.
she asked a passer-by for help.
help was sought from a passer-by.
questions.explanation: The participial phrase "Not knowing" must refer to the grammatical subject that follows. Only "she" can be the one who does not know the address; the others make "a passer-by", "the map" or "help" the subject.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: "She is one of those teachers who ___ never late for the assembly."
questions.explanation: In "one of those ... who", the relative pronoun "who" refers to the plural "teachers", so the verb is plural: "are". The singular forms wrongly attach to "one".

questions.question: Which of the following is a correct cleft sentence that emphasises "the principal" in "The principal announced the results"?
options: It was the principal what announced the results.
It was the principal who announced the results.
There was the principal announced the results.
The principal it was announced the results.
questions.explanation: A cleft sentence has the pattern "It + be + focused element + that/who + clause". "What" cannot introduce the cleft clause here, and the other options are not grammatical.

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect form: He said, "I will have finished the work by Monday."
options: He said that he will have finished the work by Monday.
He said that he had finished the work by Monday.
He said that he would have finished the work by Monday.
He said that he would finish the work by Monday.
questions.explanation: With a past reporting verb, "will" backshifts to "would" and the future perfect stays perfect: "would have finished". "Had finished" changes the time reference, and "would finish" drops the perfect aspect.

questions.question: Which sentence suggests that ALL the students had cheated?
options: The students who had cheated were punished.
The students that had cheated were punished.
Only the students who had cheated were punished.
The students, who had cheated, were punished.
questions.explanation: A non-defining clause (set off by commas) adds extra information about the whole group, so all students cheated. The defining versions pick out only some students from a larger group.

questions.question: Choose the correct reply: "Have you been selected for the post?" — "I'm afraid ___."
questions.explanation: "I'm afraid not" is the fixed substitute for a whole negative clause ("I have not been selected"). "No", "none" and "neither" cannot substitute a clause after "I'm afraid".

questions.question: Choose the correct option: "Neither the manager nor the clerks ___ aware of the change in the schedule."
questions.explanation: With "neither ... nor", the verb agrees with the noun nearest to it (proximity rule). "Clerks" is plural and the sentence is in the past, so "were" is correct.

questions.question: Choose the best option: "The lights are off and the car has gone, so they ___ left already."
questions.explanation: "Must have + past participle" expresses a logical deduction about the past from present evidence. "Should/ought to have" express unfulfilled duty; "can have" is not used for affirmative deduction.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: "The shopkeeper didn't have ___ change, so I had to pay by card."
questions.explanation: "Change" (small money) is uncountable, so a quantifier for uncountables ("much") is required in a negative sentence. "Many", "a few" and "several" go with countable plurals.

questions.question: In the sentence "The negotiations between the two companies fell through", the phrasal verb "fell through" means:
questions.explanation: "Fall through" means that a plan or deal fails to happen. The other options give a literal, opposite or unrelated meaning.

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: "She hardly ever complains, ___?"
questions.explanation: "Hardly ever" has a negative force, so the statement counts as negative and takes a positive tag; the auxiliary is "does" because the verb is simple present.

questions.question: Convert into a complex sentence: "Despite his poverty, he remained honest."
options: Because he was poor, he remained honest.
Although he was poor, he remained honest.
If he was poor, he remained honest.
He was poor and he remained honest.
questions.explanation: "Despite + noun" expresses concession, which becomes an adverb clause of concession with "although". "Because" and "if" change the meaning; the last option is a compound sentence.

questions.question: Which sentence is closest in meaning to "Were he to apologise, I would forgive him"?
options: If he were to apologise, I would forgive him.
If he apologises, I will forgive him.
If he had apologised, I would have forgiven him.
Unless he apologises, I would forgive him.
questions.explanation: Inverted "Were he to" is the formal equivalent of "If he were to", a hypothetical present/future condition. The others change the type of conditional or reverse the meaning.

questions.question: The Latin root "cred" in "credulous" means:
questions.explanation: "Cred" means to believe (credible, credence, credulous = ready to believe). "Fear", "grow" and "cut" correspond to other roots.

questions.question: Which of the following words is a blend (portmanteau) formed from two words?
questions.explanation: "Smog" combines parts of "smoke" and "fog". "Cupboard" and "sunrise" are compounds of whole words, and "unlock" is formed with the prefix un-.

questions.question: In "The boat was stuck fast on the sandbank", the word "fast" means:
questions.explanation: As an adverb, "fast" can mean firmly/securely (stuck fast, fast asleep). "Quickly" is its commoner sense, and "without food" is the verb/noun sense, neither suiting "stuck".

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "The judgment set a ___ for similar cases in the future."
questions.explanation: "Precedent" is an earlier case or example followed later. "President" is a head of state, "precedence" is priority, and "presidence" is not a standard word.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "The doctor tried to ___ the patient's family that the surgery was safe."
questions.explanation: "Assure" takes a person as object (assure someone that...). "Ensure" means make certain, "insure" relates to insurance, and "ascertain" means find out.

questions.question: Choose the word that collocates with "complaint": "He ___ a formal complaint against the officer."
questions.explanation: The fixed collocation is "lodge a complaint". The other verbs are not used with "complaint" in this sense.

questions.question: In which sentence is "but" used as a preposition?
options: All but one student passed the test.
She is not rich, but she is happy.
questions.explanation: In "all but one", "but" means "except" and is followed by a noun phrase, so it is a preposition. In the others it joins words or clauses and is a conjunction.

questions.question: The bundle "in the light of" is closest in meaning to:
questions.explanation: "In the light of" means taking something into account. It is figurative; "illuminated by" is literal, and "despite"/"instead of" signal contrast and replacement.

questions.question: The idiom "to cross the Rubicon" means:
options: to travel to a foreign land
questions.explanation: Julius Caesar's crossing of the Rubicon river began a civil war and could not be undone; the idiom signifies passing a point of no return.

questions.question: The expression "halcyon days" refers to:
options: a calm, happy and peaceful period
questions.explanation: In legend the halcyon (kingfisher) calmed the sea to nest; the phrase denotes peaceful, happy times, often in the past.

questions.question: "It was not a bad performance", said of a brilliant one, is an example of:
questions.explanation: Litotes affirms something by negating its opposite as understatement. Hyperbole exaggerates; euphemism softens an unpleasant truth; irony of fate is not a device of this type.

questions.question: In Gray's line "The ploughman homeward plods his weary way", the figure of speech is:
questions.explanation: "Weary" properly describes the ploughman, but is transferred to "way". This is a transferred epithet (hypallage).

questions.question: "O Death, where is thy sting?" is an example of:
questions.explanation: Addressing an abstract idea or absent being directly is apostrophe. A soliloquy is a speech in drama; euphemism softens; metaphor implies comparison.

questions.question: "The Crown rejected the proposal" uses "Crown" as an example of:
questions.explanation: An associated object (the crown) stands for the monarchy or government it symbolises, which is metonymy. Synecdoche uses a part for the whole or vice versa.

questions.question: "Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country" is an example of:
questions.explanation: The second half reverses the word order of the first (country-you / you-country), which is chiasmus. Epistrophe repeats ending words, pleonasm is redundancy, and anticlimax is a sudden drop in importance.

questions.question: Which one of the following statements about lichens is NOT supported by the passage?
options: The fungal partner gives the lichen its structure.
Sulphur dioxide can harm the algal partner of a lichen.
Every tree trunk without lichens shows that the air is polluted.
Lichen growth can help in dating certain rock surfaces.
questions.explanation: The passage warns that absence of lichens may also result from surface age, dryness or bark clearing, so pollution cannot be concluded from one bare trunk. The other statements are stated directly.

questions.question: The "apparent weakness" of lichens refers to their:
options: inability to filter what they absorb
questions.explanation: The sentence before it says lichens have no roots and absorb substances directly, so cannot filter them. Slow growth is mentioned later as a separate feature, and the other options are not weaknesses described.

questions.question: The expression "tells a story" in the passage is:
options: a literal reference to oral tradition
a metaphor suggesting that a bare trunk conveys information
questions.explanation: A trunk does not literally narrate; it is figuratively said to convey information about pollution. Nothing in the clause is ironic or understated.

questions.question: As used in the passage, "calibrated" most nearly means:
options: checked and adjusted against a known standard
questions.explanation: The method is "calibrated only against surfaces of known age", i.e. tested against a standard. The other options do not fit the context of dating.

questions.question: The writer's attitude towards using lichens as pollution indicators is best described as:
questions.explanation: The author praises lichens' usefulness yet qualifies each claim ("the inference is not straightforward"), showing caution and analysis, not dismissal, promotion or nostalgia.

questions.question: The phrase "each lamp a small, unlit conviction" suggests that the lamps are:
options: full of potential value that is not yet visible
questions.explanation: Equating lamps with an unlit "conviction" implies a belief or worth waiting to be lit/recognised. It does not mean the lamps are faulty or restricted to a group.

questions.question: "Bright indifference" is an example of:
questions.explanation: "Bright" suggests warmth/attention while "indifference" denotes the opposite, giving a two-word contradiction, i.e. an oxymoron.

questions.question: Which statement best captures the main thought of 'The Lamp-Seller's Evening'?
options: true worth is often recognised only when the need for it arises
people are naturally cruel to the poor
power cuts are inevitable in cities
questions.explanation: The third and fourth stanzas show passers-by returning during a power cut, and "worth is slow, and goes unpriced until the evening asks for it" states the idea directly.

questions.question: The line "they praise the shine and leave the shine" implies that people:
options: buy the lamps but dislike their brightness
admire the appearance of things without valuing their purpose
are unable to afford the lamps
questions.explanation: They praise the shine yet do not buy: they enjoy surface beauty but ignore the lamp's function, as the next line says ("only what it holds"). Nothing suggests distrust or poverty.

questions.question: The tone of the final stanza is one of:
questions.explanation: He "does not gloat", counts windows, not coins, and calls it "a good day's trade", which shows calm satisfaction, not bitterness, loud triumph or despair.

questions.question: Verma's remark that "registers that are too honest make the department look bad" shows that he wants:
options: the figures adjusted to present a better picture
Meena to be praised for her honesty
the register to be sent for an audit
attendance to be recorded less often
questions.explanation: He calls 91 per cent "comfortable", hinting that the numbers should be raised. He is not praising Meena or ordering an audit.

questions.question: Meena's question "Comfortable for whom?" is best described as:
options: a challenge exposing who actually benefits
an admission of her own mistake
questions.explanation: It is not a genuine request for information; it pointedly questions whose interest the inflated figures serve.

questions.question: Meena's comparison of truth to a roof implies that truth:
options: belongs to the person in authority
matters only in the rainy season
gives necessary protection and cannot be wished away
questions.explanation: A roof shelters people, and "remove it, and the rain still comes" means reality persists even when truth is hidden. Verma's "furniture" image is the opposing view.

questions.question: Verma's last line, "do not expect gratitude from the file", is spoken in a tone that is:
questions.explanation: He accepts "Revise nothing" after a long silence, but with a dry remark about the system, suggesting grudging respect and resignation, not hostility or indifference.

questions.question: Which of the following can be reasonably inferred from the extract?
options: Meena has often been punished for lateness.
Verma will report Meena to higher authorities.
Verma is under institutional pressure to show better figures.
Verma is unaware that children help in the paddy harvest.
questions.explanation: His remark that honest registers "make the department look bad" implies pressure from the system. The extract says nothing of punishment, a report, or his ignorance of the harvest.

questions.question: According to Swain's Output Hypothesis, producing language (speaking or writing) helps a learner mainly by:
questions.questionHi: स्वेन की आउटपुट परिकल्पना के अनुसार भाषा का उत्पादन (बोलना या लिखना) सीखने वाले की मुख्यतः किस प्रकार मदद करता है?
options: replacing the need for any input
making the learner notice gaps in his/her interlanguage and test hypotheses
optionsHi: किसी भी इनपुट की आवश्यकता समाप्त करके
सही रूपों को अपने-आप स्थायी बनाकर
केवल सीखने वाले की चिंता कम करके
अपनी अंतरभाषा (interlanguage) की कमियों को पहचानने और परिकल्पनाओं को परखने में
questions.explanation: Swain argued that pushed output forces learners to notice what they cannot yet say, test hypotheses and reflect on form. It complements, not replaces, input.
questions.explanationHi: स्वेन के अनुसार "पुश्ड आउटपुट" सीखने वाले को यह पहचानने पर मजबूर करता है कि वह क्या नहीं कह पा रहा है, इससे वह परिकल्पनाएँ परखता और रूप पर विचार करता है। यह इनपुट का स्थान नहीं लेता, उसका पूरक है।

questions.question: According to Krashen's Affective Filter Hypothesis, comprehensible input is likely to be blocked from acquisition when the learner has:
questions.questionHi: क्रैशेन की भावात्मक छन्नी (Affective Filter) परिकल्पना के अनुसार बोधगम्य इनपुट का अर्जन कब बाधित होता है, जब सीखने वाले में:
options: high motivation and a relaxed attitude
high anxiety, low motivation and low self-confidence
a large vocabulary of the first language
optionsHi: अधिक प्रेरणा और सहज रवैया हो
अधिक चिंता, कम प्रेरणा और कम आत्मविश्वास हो
प्रथम भाषा की बड़ी शब्दावली हो
प्रामाणिक पाठों से बार-बार संपर्क हो
questions.explanation: The "filter" rises with anxiety, low motivation and low self-confidence and keeps input from reaching the acquisition device. Motivation, relaxation and exposure lower the filter.
questions.explanationHi: चिंता, कम प्रेरणा और कम आत्मविश्वास से "फ़िल्टर" ऊँचा हो जाता है और इनपुट अर्जन तंत्र तक नहीं पहुँच पाता। प्रेरणा, सहजता और संपर्क फ़िल्टर को कम करते हैं।

questions.question: Bruner's concept of the Language Acquisition Support System (LASS) emphasises that children acquire language mainly through:
questions.questionHi: ब्रूनर की भाषा अर्जन सहायता प्रणाली (LASS) की अवधारणा के अनुसार बच्चे भाषा मुख्यतः किसके माध्यम से सीखते हैं?
options: structured, routine social interaction with caregivers
an inborn grammar module working alone
optionsHi: देखभालकर्ताओं के साथ सुव्यवस्थित, नियमित सामाजिक अंतःक्रिया
अकेले कार्य करने वाले जन्मजात व्याकरण मॉड्यूल
questions.explanation: Bruner proposed LASS as the social framework (games, routines, scaffolded talk) that supports the child, in contrast with the innate LAD of Chomsky working in isolation.
questions.explanationHi: ब्रूनर ने LASS को सामाजिक ढाँचा (खेल, दिनचर्या, स्कैफोल्डेड बातचीत) माना जो बच्चे की मदद करता है; इसके विपरीत चॉम्स्की का जन्मजात LAD अकेले कार्य करता है।

questions.question: Krashen's Natural Order Hypothesis implies that a teacher should NOT assume that:
questions.questionHi: क्रैशेन की स्वाभाविक क्रम (Natural Order) परिकल्पना के अनुसार शिक्षक को यह नहीं मान लेना चाहिए कि:
options: learners acquire grammatical morphemes in a fairly predictable order
the order is similar across many learners
grammatical items learnt first in the textbook sequence will be acquired first
optionsHi: विद्यार्थी व्याकरणिक रूपिमों को काफ़ी पूर्वानुमेय क्रम में अर्जित करते हैं
यह क्रम अनेक विद्यार्थियों में समान होता है
पाठ्यपुस्तक के क्रम में पहले पढ़ाई गई व्याकरणिक इकाइयाँ पहले अर्जित होंगी
अर्जन सार्थक इनपुट से होता है
questions.explanation: The hypothesis says morphemes are acquired in a predictable order (e.g. -ing early, third-person -s late) regardless of the order in which they are taught, so a textbook sequence does not decide acquisition order. The other statements are consistent with it.
questions.explanationHi: परिकल्पना के अनुसार रूपिम एक पूर्वानुमेय क्रम में अर्जित होते हैं (जैसे -ing जल्दी, third-person -s देर से), चाहे उन्हें किसी भी क्रम में पढ़ाया जाए; इसलिए पाठ्यपुस्तक का क्रम अर्जन का क्रम तय नहीं करता। अन्य कथन इसके अनुरूप हैं।

questions.question: In Krashen and Terrell's Natural Approach, the 'silent period' implies that:
questions.questionHi: क्रैशेन और टेरेल के नेचुरल अप्रोच में "मौन अवधि (silent period)" का अर्थ है कि:
options: learners must repeat every sentence silently
the teacher avoids speaking in the target language
learners are not forced to speak until they feel ready
optionsHi: विद्यार्थी हर वाक्य को मन में दोहराएँ
लिखित कार्य पर स्थायी रोक होती है
जब तक विद्यार्थी तैयार न हों, उन्हें बोलने के लिए बाध्य नहीं किया जाता
questions.explanation: The Natural Approach lets learners listen first and begin speaking when ready, lowering anxiety (affective filter). The other options misdescribe it.
questions.explanationHi: नेचुरल अप्रोच में विद्यार्थी पहले सुनते हैं और तैयार होने पर बोलना शुरू करते हैं, जिससे चिंता कम होती है (affective filter)। अन्य विकल्प इसका गलत वर्णन करते हैं।

questions.question: A learner forgets the word "umbrella" and says "the thing we open in the rain to protect ourselves". Which component of communicative competence (Canale and Swain) is being used?
questions.questionHi: एक विद्यार्थी "umbrella" शब्द भूल जाता है और कहता है "वह चीज़ जिसे हम बारिश में खोलकर बचाव करते हैं"। कैनेल और स्वेन के संप्रेषणीय सामर्थ्य का कौन-सा घटक प्रयुक्त हो रहा है?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase or circumlocution to compensate for a gap in knowledge is a communication strategy, i.e. strategic competence. The other components concern rules of form, appropriateness and cohesion.
questions.explanationHi: ज्ञान की कमी की भरपाई के लिए अन्य शब्दों में बात कहना संप्रेषण-रणनीति है, यानी रणनीतिक सामर्थ्य। अन्य घटक रूप के नियमों, उपयुक्तता और संसक्ति से संबंधित हैं।

questions.question: Hymes criticised Chomsky's concept of linguistic competence mainly because it:
questions.questionHi: हाइम्स ने चॉम्स्की की भाषिक सामर्थ्य की अवधारणा की मुख्यतः यह कहकर आलोचना की कि वह:
options: over-emphasises the role of the learner's motivation
treats language as a learned habit
ignores the sociocultural rules of appropriate language use
rejects the idea of an innate capacity
optionsHi: सीखने वाले की प्रेरणा पर अत्यधिक बल देती है
भाषा को सीखी हुई आदत मानती है
भाषा-प्रयोग के उपयुक्त सामाजिक-सांस्कृतिक नियमों की उपेक्षा करती है
जन्मजात क्षमता के विचार को अस्वीकार करती है
questions.explanation: Hymes argued that knowing grammar is not enough; speakers must know when, where and to whom to say what. Habit formation is the behaviourist view, and Chomsky himself proposed an innate capacity.
questions.explanationHi: हाइम्स के अनुसार केवल व्याकरण जानना पर्याप्त नहीं; वक्ता को यह भी पता होना चाहिए कि कब, कहाँ और किससे क्या कहना है। आदत-निर्माण व्यवहारवादी मत है और जन्मजात क्षमता का विचार स्वयं चॉम्स्की का था।

questions.question: Error Analysis differs from Contrastive Analysis in that it:
questions.questionHi: त्रुटि-विश्लेषण (Error Analysis), तुलनात्मक विश्लेषण (Contrastive Analysis) से इस प्रकार भिन्न है कि वह:
options: studies learners' actual errors and recognises sources other than L1 interference
predicts all errors by comparing L1 and L2 before teaching
claims that errors should never be analysed
considers all errors to be caused by L1 transfer
optionsHi: सीखने वालों की वास्तविक त्रुटियों का अध्ययन करता है और L1 हस्तक्षेप के अलावा अन्य स्रोतों को भी मानता है
शिक्षण से पहले L1 और L2 की तुलना करके सभी त्रुटियों की भविष्यवाणी करता है
मानता है कि त्रुटियों का विश्लेषण कभी नहीं करना चाहिए
सभी त्रुटियों को L1 अंतरण का परिणाम मानता है
questions.explanation: Contrastive Analysis predicted difficulty from L1-L2 differences. Error Analysis starts from learners' real errors and finds interlingual and intralingual causes (e.g. overgeneralisation).
questions.explanationHi: तुलनात्मक विश्लेषण L1-L2 के अंतर से कठिनाई की भविष्यवाणी करता था। त्रुटि-विश्लेषण सीखने वालों की वास्तविक त्रुटियों से शुरू करके अंतर-भाषिक और अंतः-भाषिक (जैसे अतिसामान्यीकरण) कारण खोजता है।

questions.question: A learner has said "He go to office" for years despite constant exposure and correction. This persistent non-target form illustrates:
questions.questionHi: एक विद्यार्थी लगातार संपर्क और सुधार के बावजूद वर्षों से "He go to office" कहता है। यह स्थायी गलत रूप किसका उदाहरण है?
questions.explanation: Fossilisation is the permanent stabilisation of incorrect forms in interlanguage. Code-switching is alternating languages, hypercorrection is wrongly altering correct forms, and a slip is a one-off performance lapse.
questions.explanationHi: अंतरभाषा में गलत रूपों का स्थायी रूप से जम जाना fossilisation कहलाता है। कोड-स्विचिंग भाषाओं का बदलना है, hypercorrection सही रूप को गलत बदलना है और slip एक बार की चूक है।

questions.question: According to Krashen's Monitor Hypothesis, learned grammar rules can be used to edit output effectively only when the performer:
questions.questionHi: क्रैशेन की मॉनिटर परिकल्पना के अनुसार सीखे हुए व्याकरण नियम तभी प्रभावी रूप से अपने उत्पादन को सुधारते हैं जब वक्ता:
options: is speaking spontaneously at normal speed
has high anxiety and low motivation
has enough time, focuses on form and knows the rule
optionsHi: सामान्य गति से सहज रूप से बोल रहा हो
उसमें अधिक चिंता और कम प्रेरणा हो
नियम को अवचेतन रूप से अर्जित कर रहा हो
के पास पर्याप्त समय हो, वह रूप पर ध्यान दे और नियम जानता हो
questions.explanation: The Monitor edits output only when three conditions are met: time, focus on form, and knowledge of the rule. Spontaneous speech leaves no time for monitoring.
questions.explanationHi: मॉनिटर तभी काम करता है जब तीन शर्तें पूरी हों: समय, रूप पर ध्यान और नियम का ज्ञान। सहज बोलचाल में मॉनिटर करने का समय नहीं होता।

questions.question: In Anderson and Krathwohl's revised taxonomy, which language task belongs to the highest level, 'Create'?
questions.questionHi: एंडरसन और क्रैथवोल के संशोधित वर्गीकरण में कौन-सा भाषा-कार्य सर्वोच्च स्तर "सृजन (Create)" का है?
options: Identifying the main idea of a paragraph
Summarising a poem in own words
Composing an original short story or dialogue
optionsHi: कविता का सार अपने शब्दों में लिखना
मौलिक लघु कहानी या संवाद लिखना
शब्दों का उनके अर्थों से मिलान करना
questions.explanation: Generating something new is "Create". Matching words is Remember, summarising is Understand, and identifying the main idea is Understand/Analyse.
questions.explanationHi: कुछ नया रचना "Create" स्तर है। शब्द मिलाना Remember, सार लिखना Understand और मुख्य विचार पहचानना Understand/Analyse स्तर का कार्य है।

questions.question: Which classroom practice best illustrates scaffolding within the learner's Zone of Proximal Development?
questions.questionHi: विद्यार्थी के निकटतम विकास क्षेत्र (ZPD) में स्कैफोल्डिंग का सबसे अच्छा उदाहरण कौन-सी कक्षा-गतिविधि है?
options: Giving sentence starters and a model paragraph, then gradually withdrawing them as the learner improves
Giving the same fixed worksheet to all learners
Correcting every error immediately and permanently supplying answers
Assigning tasks far beyond what the learner can do even with help
optionsHi: वाक्य-आरंभ और नमूना अनुच्छेद देना, फिर विद्यार्थी के सुधरने पर उन्हें धीरे-धीरे हटाना
सभी विद्यार्थियों को एक ही निश्चित कार्यपत्रक देना
हर त्रुटि तुरंत सुधारना और हमेशा उत्तर बताते रहना
ऐसे कार्य देना जो सहायता से भी विद्यार्थी की क्षमता से बहुत परे हों
questions.explanation: Scaffolding is temporary, adjustable support that is faded as competence grows. Permanent support removes independence; tasks beyond the ZPD or identical tasks ignore it.
questions.explanationHi: स्कैफोल्डिंग अस्थायी और समायोज्य सहायता है जो योग्यता बढ़ने पर हटाई जाती है। स्थायी सहायता स्वतंत्रता छीन लेती है; ZPD से बाहर के या एक-जैसे कार्य इसे नज़रअंदाज़ करते हैं।

questions.question: The '4Cs' framework of CLIL (Content and Language Integrated Learning) consists of:
questions.questionHi: CLIL (Content and Language Integrated Learning) के "4Cs" ढाँचे में कौन-से घटक हैं?
questions.explanation: Coyle's 4Cs framework integrates subject Content, Communication (language), Cognition (thinking) and Culture (intercultural understanding).
questions.explanationHi: कॉयल के 4Cs ढाँचे में विषय-वस्तु (Content), भाषा-संप्रेषण (Communication), चिंतन (Cognition) और संस्कृति (Culture) का समेकन है।

questions.question: In a multilingual classroom, "translanguaging" as a teaching strategy means:
questions.questionHi: बहुभाषी कक्षा में "ट्रांसलैंग्वेजिंग" शिक्षण-रणनीति का अर्थ है:
options: banning the home language in the classroom
translating every English word into Hindi in writing only
purposefully using learners' whole linguistic repertoire to build understanding
teaching two languages in alternate years
optionsHi: कक्षा में घर की भाषा पर रोक लगाना
हर अंग्रेज़ी शब्द का केवल लिखित हिंदी अनुवाद करना
समझ विकसित करने के लिए विद्यार्थियों के संपूर्ण भाषिक भंडार का उद्देश्यपूर्ण उपयोग करना
वैकल्पिक वर्षों में दो भाषाएँ पढ़ाना
questions.explanation: Translanguaging treats the learner's languages as resources: learners may discuss, read or plan in L1 while producing English. A ban or mechanical translation does the opposite.
questions.explanationHi: ट्रांसलैंग्वेजिंग में विद्यार्थी की सभी भाषाओं को संसाधन माना जाता है: वह L1 में चर्चा, पठन या योजना बना सकता है और अंग्रेज़ी में प्रस्तुति दे सकता है। प्रतिबंध या यांत्रिक अनुवाद इसके विपरीत है।

questions.question: Which sequence best represents a sound remedial teaching cycle for a language learner?
questions.questionHi: भाषा सीखने वाले के लिए उचित उपचारात्मक शिक्षण चक्र का सबसे अच्छा क्रम कौन-सा है?
options: Repeat the whole syllabus, punish errors, hold a test
Give more homework, wait, promote the learner
Re-assess, diagnose, repeat the lesson unchanged
Diagnose the difficulty, analyse its causes, plan targeted activities, re-assess
optionsHi: पूरा पाठ्यक्रम दोहराना, त्रुटियों पर दंड, परीक्षा लेना
अधिक गृहकार्य देना, प्रतीक्षा करना, विद्यार्थी को आगे बढ़ा देना
पुनर्मूल्यांकन, निदान, पाठ को बिना बदले दोहराना
कठिनाई का निदान, कारणों का विश्लेषण, लक्षित गतिविधियों की योजना, पुनर्मूल्यांकन
questions.explanation: Remedial teaching is diagnostic-driven: find what is wrong, why, design focused practice, then check progress. Repetition without diagnosis rarely addresses the real problem.
questions.explanationHi: उपचारात्मक शिक्षण निदान-आधारित होता है: क्या गलत है, क्यों, फिर लक्षित अभ्यास और अंत में प्रगति की जाँच। निदान के बिना दोहराव वास्तविक समस्या हल नहीं करता।

questions.question: A 15-year-old keeps asking "Who am I and where do I belong?" According to Erikson, he is going through the crisis of:
questions.questionHi: एक 15 वर्षीय किशोर बार-बार पूछता है, "मैं कौन हूँ और मेरा स्थान कहाँ है?" एरिक्सन के अनुसार वह किस संकट से गुज़र रहा है?
optionsHi: पहचान बनाम भूमिका-भ्रम (Identity vs role confusion)
questions.explanation: Identity vs role confusion is the adolescent stage. Industry vs inferiority is middle childhood, intimacy vs isolation is young adulthood, and initiative vs guilt is the preschool stage.
questions.explanationHi: पहचान बनाम भूमिका-भ्रम किशोरावस्था का चरण है। उद्यमशीलता बनाम हीनता मध्य बाल्यावस्था, घनिष्ठता बनाम अलगाव युवावस्था और पहल बनाम अपराध-बोध पूर्वस्कूल अवस्था का चरण है।

questions.question: Unlike Piaget, who regarded private speech as egocentric and immature, Vygotsky viewed it as:
questions.questionHi: पियाजे निजी वाणी को अहंकेंद्रित और अपरिपक्व मानते थे, जबकि वायगोत्स्की ने उसे माना:
options: a habit to be discouraged in class
a tool for thinking and self-regulation that later becomes inner speech
an innate reflex that disappears at birth
optionsHi: कक्षा में हतोत्साहित की जाने वाली आदत
चिंतन और आत्म-नियमन का साधन, जो आगे चलकर आंतरिक वाणी बन जाता है
जन्मजात प्रतिवर्त जो जन्म के समय ही समाप्त हो जाता है
questions.explanation: For Vygotsky, children talk to themselves to plan and control behaviour; this speech is internalised as inner speech. Piaget saw it as a failure to take the listener into account.
questions.explanationHi: वायगोत्स्की के अनुसार बच्चे योजना बनाने और व्यवहार नियंत्रित करने के लिए स्वयं से बोलते हैं; यह वाणी आगे आंतरिक वाणी बन जाती है। पियाजे इसे श्रोता को ध्यान में न रख पाने का संकेत मानते थे।

questions.question: A student who believes she is good at writing puts in more effort, gets better marks, and so believes in herself even more. This mutual influence of person, behaviour and environment illustrates:
questions.questionHi: एक छात्रा मानती है कि वह लेखन में अच्छी है, इसलिए अधिक मेहनत करती है, अच्छे अंक पाती है और उसका आत्मविश्वास और बढ़ जाता है। व्यक्ति, व्यवहार और पर्यावरण का यह परस्पर प्रभाव किसका उदाहरण है?
optionsHi: केवल थॉर्नडाइक का अभ्यास का नियम
questions.explanation: Bandura's reciprocal determinism holds that personal factors (beliefs), behaviour and environment continuously influence each other. The other options describe different learning ideas.
questions.explanationHi: बंडूरा के पारस्परिक नियतिवाद के अनुसार व्यक्तिगत कारक (विश्वास), व्यवहार और पर्यावरण एक-दूसरे को लगातार प्रभावित करते हैं। अन्य विकल्प अलग धारणाओं के हैं।

questions.question: In Cattell's theory of intelligence, which ability generally continues to grow or remain stable through adulthood because it depends on accumulated knowledge?
questions.questionHi: कैटेल के बुद्धि सिद्धांत में कौन-सी योग्यता संचित ज्ञान पर निर्भर होने के कारण वयस्कता में प्रायः बढ़ती या स्थिर रहती है?
questions.explanation: Crystallised intelligence (vocabulary, general knowledge) reflects learning and experience and holds up with age. Fluid intelligence (novel problem-solving) peaks earlier and declines. Spatial and emotional intelligences are not Cattell's categories.
questions.explanationHi: क्रिस्टलीकृत बुद्धि (शब्दावली, सामान्य ज्ञान) अनुभव और अधिगम पर निर्भर है और आयु के साथ बनी रहती है। तरल बुद्धि (नई समस्याएँ हल करना) पहले चरम पर पहुँचकर घटती है। स्थानिक और संवेगात्मक बुद्धि कैटेल की श्रेणियाँ नहीं हैं।

questions.question: In the "uses of a brick" test of divergent thinking, a student lists uses from many different categories (building, weapon, paperweight, art). This reflects high:
questions.questionHi: "ईंट के उपयोग" वाले अपसारी चिंतन परीक्षण में एक विद्यार्थी अनेक भिन्न श्रेणियों (निर्माण, हथियार, पेपरवेट, कला) के उपयोग लिखता है। यह किसमें उच्चता दर्शाता है?
questions.explanation: Flexibility is the number of different categories of ideas. Fluency is the total number of ideas, elaboration is the detail added, and convergent thinking seeks one correct answer.
questions.explanationHi: लचीलापन भिन्न श्रेणियों के विचारों की संख्या है। प्रवाह कुल विचारों की संख्या है, विस्तारण में विवरण जोड़ना है और अभिसारी चिंतन एक सही उत्तर खोजता है।

questions.question: A 10-month-old pushes a pillow aside to reach a hidden toy, using one action as a means to another. In Piaget's sensorimotor stage this is the substage of:
questions.questionHi: एक 10 माह का शिशु छिपे खिलौने तक पहुँचने के लिए तकिया हटाता है, यानी एक क्रिया को दूसरी क्रिया का साधन बनाता है। पियाजे की संवेदी-गामक अवस्था में यह कौन-सी उप-अवस्था है?
questions.explanation: Around 8-12 months infants coordinate schemes in a means-end way and search for hidden objects. Reflexes are 0-1 month, primary reactions 1-4 months and tertiary reactions (experimenting) 12-18 months.
questions.explanationHi: लगभग 8-12 माह में शिशु क्रियाओं का साधन-साध्य रूप में समन्वय करता है और छिपी वस्तु खोजता है। प्रतिवर्त 0-1 माह, प्राथमिक प्रतिक्रियाएँ 1-4 माह और तृतीयक प्रतिक्रियाएँ (प्रयोग करना) 12-18 माह की हैं।

questions.question: In item analysis, an item with a difficulty index of 0.85 is:
questions.questionHi: प्रश्न-विश्लेषण में 0.85 कठिनाई-स्तर वाला प्रश्न है:
options: a very difficult item, answered correctly by 15 per cent
a very easy item, answered correctly by 85 per cent of examinees
an item that must be of average difficulty
optionsHi: बहुत कठिन प्रश्न, जिसे 15 प्रतिशत ने सही हल किया
बहुत सरल प्रश्न, जिसे 85 प्रतिशत परीक्षार्थियों ने सही हल किया
questions.explanation: The difficulty index (p) is the proportion answering correctly, so a higher value means an easier item. It says nothing directly about discrimination.
questions.explanationHi: कठिनाई-स्तर (p) सही उत्तर देने वालों का अनुपात है, इसलिए अधिक मान का अर्थ सरल प्रश्न है। यह विभेदन के बारे में सीधे कुछ नहीं बताता।

questions.question: Correlating scores on the odd-numbered items with scores on the even-numbered items and applying the Spearman-Brown formula estimates:
questions.questionHi: विषम संख्या वाले प्रश्नों के अंकों का सम संख्या वाले प्रश्नों के अंकों से सहसंबंध निकालकर स्पीयरमैन-ब्राउन सूत्र लगाने से क्या आकलित होता है?
questions.explanation: Splitting one test into two halves and correcting the half-test correlation with Spearman-Brown gives split-half reliability. Test-retest needs two administrations; inter-rater needs two scorers; validity is a different property.
questions.explanationHi: एक परीक्षण को दो भागों में बाँटकर अर्ध-परीक्षण सहसंबंध को स्पीयरमैन-ब्राउन से सुधारने पर अर्ध-विभाजन विश्वसनीयता मिलती है। पुनर्परीक्षण में दो बार परीक्षा होती है, अंतर-मूल्यांकनकर्ता में दो जाँचकर्ता होते हैं और वैधता अलग गुण है।

questions.question: The correlation between marks in an entrance test and the same students' marks at the end of the first year indicates:
questions.questionHi: प्रवेश परीक्षा के अंकों और उन्हीं विद्यार्थियों के प्रथम वर्ष के अंत के अंकों के बीच सहसंबंध किसे दर्शाता है?
questions.explanation: Predictive validity is the extent to which a test score predicts later performance on a criterion. Face and content validity concern appearance and coverage; "concurrent reliability" is not a standard type.
questions.explanationHi: भविष्यसूचक वैधता यह बताती है कि परीक्षण के अंक बाद के प्रदर्शन का कितना पूर्वानुमान देते हैं। आकृति और विषयवस्तु वैधता दिखावट और आच्छादन से संबंधित हैं; "concurrent reliability" मानक प्रकार नहीं है।

questions.question: NEP 2020's proposed Holistic Progress Card is described as a 360-degree report because it includes:
questions.questionHi: NEP 2020 में प्रस्तावित समग्र प्रगति कार्ड (Holistic Progress Card) को 360-डिग्री रिपोर्ट इसलिए कहा गया है क्योंकि उसमें शामिल होता है:
options: only the teacher's remarks on conduct
self-assessment, peer assessment and teacher assessment
only a ranking of students in the class
optionsHi: केवल आचरण पर शिक्षक की टिप्पणी
केवल कक्षा में विद्यार्थियों की रैंक
questions.explanation: The card records progress in cognitive, affective and psychomotor domains through self, peer and teacher assessment, not just marks or rank.
questions.explanationHi: यह कार्ड संज्ञानात्मक, भावात्मक और मनोगामक क्षेत्रों की प्रगति स्व-, सहपाठी- और शिक्षक-आकलन से दर्ज करता है, केवल अंक या रैंक से नहीं।

questions.question: In NCF for School Education 2023, the "Preparatory Stage" covers:
questions.questionHi: स्कूली शिक्षा हेतु राष्ट्रीय पाठ्यचर्या की रूपरेखा (NCF-SE) 2023 में "तैयारी चरण (Preparatory Stage)" में कौन-सी कक्षाएँ आती हैं?
optionsHi: कक्षा 3 से 5 (लगभग 8 से 11 वर्ष की आयु)
questions.explanation: The 5+3+3+4 structure has Foundational (ages 3-8), Preparatory (Grades 3-5), Middle (Grades 6-8) and Secondary (Grades 9-12) stages.
questions.explanationHi: 5+3+3+4 ढाँचे में आधारभूत (3-8 वर्ष), तैयारी (कक्षा 3-5), मध्य (कक्षा 6-8) और माध्यमिक (कक्षा 9-12) चरण हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is the best-written instructional objective for a lesson on paragraph writing?
questions.questionHi: पैराग्राफ़ लेखन के पाठ के लिए निम्नलिखित में से सबसे अच्छा लिखा गया शिक्षण-उद्देश्य कौन-सा है?
options: The teacher will explain linking words.
Students will appreciate the beauty of writing.
By the end of the lesson, learners will write a 100-word paragraph on a given topic using at least three linking words.
optionsHi: विद्यार्थी लेखन की सुंदरता की सराहना करेंगे।
पाठ के अंत तक विद्यार्थी दिए गए विषय पर कम से कम तीन योजक शब्दों के प्रयोग से 100 शब्दों का अनुच्छेद लिखेंगे।
questions.explanation: A good objective is learner-centred, specific, observable and measurable. "Understand" and "appreciate" cannot be directly observed, and explaining is the teacher activity, not a learning outcome.
questions.explanationHi: अच्छा उद्देश्य विद्यार्थी-केंद्रित, विशिष्ट, देखने योग्य और मापने योग्य होता है। "समझेंगे" और "सराहना करेंगे" सीधे नहीं देखे जा सकते, और समझाना शिक्षक की गतिविधि है, सीखने का परिणाम नहीं।

questions.question: In the jigsaw technique of cooperative learning, each group member:
questions.questionHi: सहकारी अधिगम की जिगसॉ तकनीक में समूह का प्रत्येक सदस्य:
options: becomes an expert on one part of the topic and teaches it to the others
studies the whole topic alone and is tested alone
competes with other members for the top rank
listens to the lecture of the teacher without discussion
optionsHi: विषय के एक भाग का विशेषज्ञ बनता है और उसे दूसरों को पढ़ाता है
पूरा विषय अकेले पढ़ता है और अकेले परीक्षा देता है
शीर्ष रैंक के लिए अन्य सदस्यों से प्रतिस्पर्धा करता है
बिना चर्चा के शिक्षक का व्याख्यान सुनता है
questions.explanation: Jigsaw creates positive interdependence: every member holds a unique piece of information and must teach it. It is neither individual study nor competition nor lecture.
questions.explanationHi: जिगसॉ में सकारात्मक अंतर-निर्भरता होती है: हर सदस्य के पास जानकारी का एक अलग टुकड़ा होता है और उसे पढ़ाना होता है। यह न व्यक्तिगत अध्ययन है, न प्रतियोगिता और न व्याख्यान।

questions.question: A teacher first elicits the children's existing ideas about floating and sinking, then shows a puzzling demonstration that contradicts those ideas and lets them revise their explanations. This approach reflects:
questions.questionHi: एक शिक्षक पहले तैरने और डूबने के बारे में बच्चों के पूर्व विचार जानता है, फिर एक ऐसा आश्चर्यजनक प्रदर्शन दिखाता है जो उन विचारों के विपरीत है और बच्चों को स्पष्टीकरण बदलने देता है। यह दृष्टिकोण किसे दर्शाता है?
questions.explanation: Eliciting prior knowledge and creating cognitive conflict so that learners restructure their ideas is the core of constructivist conceptual change. The other methods are teacher-centred.
questions.explanationHi: पूर्व ज्ञान जानना और संज्ञानात्मक द्वंद्व पैदा करना ताकि विद्यार्थी अपने विचारों को पुनर्गठित करें, रचनावादी संकल्पनात्मक परिवर्तन का मूल है। अन्य विधियाँ शिक्षक-केंद्रित हैं।

questions.question: In a school, boys are always asked to carry furniture and girls to sweep the room. From a gender perspective this is an example of:
questions.questionHi: एक विद्यालय में लड़कों से हमेशा फर्नीचर उठवाया जाता है और लड़कियों से कमरे की सफाई करवाई जाती है। लैंगिक दृष्टि से यह किसका उदाहरण है?
options: the hidden curriculum reinforcing gender stereotypes
optionsHi: छिपा हुआ पाठ्यक्रम जो लैंगिक रूढ़ियों को मज़बूत करता है
questions.explanation: Unwritten school practices that teach gender roles form the hidden curriculum. Equal opportunity and stereotype-free roles are expected in inclusive classrooms.
questions.explanationHi: स्कूल की अलिखित प्रथाएँ जो लैंगिक भूमिकाएँ सिखाती हैं, छिपा हुआ पाठ्यक्रम कहलाती हैं। समावेशी कक्षा में समान अवसर और रूढ़ि-मुक्त भूमिकाएँ अपेक्षित हैं।

questions.question: 'जगदीश' का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'जगत् + ईश' में त् के बाद स्वर 'ई' आने पर त् का द् हो जाता है, इसलिए 'जगदीश' बनता है। यह व्यंजन संधि है। अन्य विभाजन नियम के अनुसार सही नहीं हैं।

questions.question: 'चौराहा' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: 'चौराहा' का विग्रह 'चार राहों का समूह' है। पूर्वपद संख्यावाचक है और पूरा पद समूह का बोध कराता है, इसलिए द्विगु समास है।

questions.question: लोकोक्ति 'थोथा चना बाजे घना' का अर्थ क्या है?
options: कम गुण वाला व्यक्ति अधिक दिखावा करता है
बहुत मेहनत से सफलता मिलती है
अनाज खाने से शक्ति बढ़ती है
questions.explanation: 'थोथा' का अर्थ खोखला है। खोखला चना ज़्यादा बजता है, यानी जिसमें गुण कम होते हैं वह अधिक शोर और दिखावा करता है।

questions.question: 'नदी के कूल पर बैठकर उसने भोजन किया।' इस वाक्य में 'कूल' का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'कूल' का अर्थ किनारा है, जबकि 'कुल' का अर्थ वंश या संपूर्ण होता है। दोनों शब्द सुनने में समान लगते हैं पर अर्थ भिन्न हैं।

questions.question: 'पेड़ से पत्ते गिरे' - इस वाक्य में 'पेड़ से' में कौन-सा कारक है?
questions.explanation: यहाँ 'से' अलग होने का भाव बताता है (पेड़ से पत्तों का अलग होना), इसलिए अपादान कारक है। करण कारक में 'से' साधन के अर्थ में आता है (कलम से लिखा)।

questions.question: Choose the one word for: "An abnormal fear of open or crowded public spaces".
questions.explanation: "Agoraphobia" is fear of open or crowded places. Claustrophobia is fear of closed spaces, xenophobia of strangers, acrophobia of heights.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "After the war, the village was bereft ___ all its young men."
questions.explanation: "Bereft" is followed by "of" (bereft of hope/friends).

questions.question: Find the part with the error: "Hardly had he reached the station (A) / when the train (B) / had left (C) / No error (D)".
questions.explanation: With "Hardly had ... when", the second clause takes the simple past: "when the train left". "Had left" is wrong.

questions.question: The idiom "to be at sixes and sevens" means:
options: to be in a state of confusion or disorder
to be at the age of thirteen
questions.explanation: The idiom describes disorder or confusion; the other options are literal guesses.

questions.question: Change into the passive voice: "Who taught you this song?"
options: By whom is this song taught to you?
Who has this song been taught by you?
By whom was this song taught to you?
By whom has this song been taught to you?
questions.explanation: The simple past "taught" becomes "was taught"; "Who" becomes "By whom" at the start. The other options change the tense or the structure.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 6, 5, 10, 9, 18, 17, ?
If TEACHER is coded as VGCEJGT, how is STUDENT coded?
questions.questionHi: यदि TEACHER को VGCEJGT लिखा जाता है, तो STUDENT को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted two places forward: S-U, T-V, U-W, D-F, E-G, N-P, T-V, giving UVWFGPV.
questions.explanationHi: प्रत्येक अक्षर को दो स्थान आगे बढ़ाया गया है: S-U, T-V, U-W, D-F, E-G, N-P, T-V, अतः UVWFGPV।

questions.question: A is the sister of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. E is the mother of D. How is A related to E?
questions.questionHi: A, B की बहन है। C, B की माता है। D, C का पिता है। E, D की माता है। A का E से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: A and B are children of C. C is the child of D, and D is the child of E. So E is the great-grandmother of A, and A is E's great-granddaughter.
questions.explanationHi: A और B, C की संतान हैं। C, D की संतान है और D, E की संतान है। इसलिए E, A की परदादी है और A, E की परपोती है।

questions.question: Ravi walks 10 m south, turns right and walks 24 m. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.questionHi: रवि 10 मी दक्षिण चलता है, दाएँ मुड़कर 24 मी चलता है। वह आरंभिक बिंदु से कितनी दूर है?
questions.explanation: Facing south, a right turn leads west. The two legs are perpendicular, so distance = sqrt(10^2 + 24^2) = sqrt(676) = 26 m.
questions.explanationHi: दक्षिण की ओर मुख करके दाएँ मुड़ने पर पश्चिम दिशा होती है। दोनों दूरियाँ लंबवत हैं, इसलिए दूरी = sqrt(10^2 + 24^2) = sqrt(676) = 26 मी।

questions.question: If 5 March 2023 was a Sunday, which day of the week was 5 March 2021?
questions.questionHi: यदि 5 मार्च 2023 को रविवार था, तो 5 मार्च 2021 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: From 5 March 2021 to 5 March 2023 there are 365 + 365 = 730 days (2022 is not a leap year). 730 = 104 weeks + 2 days, so 2021 was two days earlier in the week: Sunday - 2 = Friday.

questions.question: If cell C1 contains =A1*$B$1 and is copied to C2, the formula in C2 becomes:
questions.questionHi: यदि सेल C1 में =A1*$B$1 है और इसे C2 में कॉपी किया जाए, तो C2 में सूत्र क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: A1 is a relative reference and changes to A2, while $B$1 is an absolute reference and stays fixed.
questions.explanationHi: A1 सापेक्ष संदर्भ है, इसलिए A2 हो जाता है, जबकि $B$1 निरपेक्ष संदर्भ है और स्थिर रहता है।

questions.question: What is the default file extension of a presentation saved in PowerPoint 2016?
questions.questionHi: PowerPoint 2016 में सहेजी गई प्रस्तुति का डिफ़ॉल्ट फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन क्या है?
questions.explanation: .pptx is the default Open XML presentation format. .ppt is the older 97-2003 format, .pps is a slide show and .potx is a template.
questions.explanationHi: .pptx डिफ़ॉल्ट Open XML प्रस्तुति फ़ॉर्मेट है। .ppt पुराना 97-2003 फ़ॉर्मेट है, .pps स्लाइड शो है और .potx टेम्पलेट है।

questions.question: Which malware replicates itself independently and spreads across networks without attaching to a host file?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सा मैलवेयर किसी होस्ट फ़ाइल से जुड़े बिना स्वयं की प्रतिलिपि बनाकर नेटवर्क में फैलता है?
questions.explanation: A worm is standalone and self-replicating. Boot sector and macro viruses attach to a boot sector or document; spyware secretly collects information.
questions.explanationHi: वर्म स्वतंत्र और स्वयं-प्रतिलिपि बनाने वाला प्रोग्राम है। बूट सेक्टर और मैक्रो वायरस बूट सेक्टर या दस्तावेज़ से जुड़ते हैं; स्पाईवेयर गुप्त रूप से जानकारी एकत्र करता है।

questions.question: Arrange from fastest to slowest: RAM, Registers, Hard disk, Cache.
questions.questionHi: सबसे तेज़ से सबसे धीमे के क्रम में लगाइए: RAM, Registers, Hard disk, Cache।
questions.explanation: Registers inside the CPU are the fastest, then cache, then main memory (RAM), and secondary storage like a hard disk is the slowest.
questions.explanationHi: CPU के अंदर के रजिस्टर सबसे तेज़ होते हैं, फिर कैश, फिर मुख्य मेमोरी (RAM) और हार्ड डिस्क जैसा द्वितीयक संग्रहण सबसे धीमा होता है।

questions.question: A company rents virtual servers, storage and networks over the internet but manages its own operating systems and applications. This is:
questions.questionHi: एक कंपनी इंटरनेट पर वर्चुअल सर्वर, स्टोरेज और नेटवर्क किराये पर लेती है, पर अपने ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम और एप्लिकेशन स्वयं सँभालती है। यह है:
questions.explanation: Infrastructure as a Service provides raw computing resources. SaaS delivers ready software, and PaaS supplies a platform for developing applications.
questions.explanationHi: IaaS मूल कंप्यूटिंग संसाधन देता है। SaaS तैयार सॉफ़्टवेयर देता है और PaaS एप्लिकेशन विकसित करने का प्लेटफ़ॉर्म देता है।

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution defines a "Money Bill"?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद "धन विधेयक" को परिभाषित करता है?
questions.explanation: Article 110 defines a Money Bill. Article 108 provides for a joint sitting, Article 112 for the annual financial statement (Budget), and Article 368 for constitutional amendment.
questions.explanationHi: अनुच्छेद 110 धन विधेयक को परिभाषित करता है। अनुच्छेद 108 संयुक्त बैठक, 112 वार्षिक वित्तीय विवरण (बजट) और 368 संविधान संशोधन से संबंधित है।

questions.question: The Ilbert Bill controversy of 1883 was about:
questions.questionHi: 1883 का इल्बर्ट बिल विवाद किससे संबंधित था?
options: the right of Indian judges to try European offenders in criminal cases
the ban on the Indian-language press
the reduction of import duty on cotton
optionsHi: भारतीय न्यायाधीशों को यूरोपीय अपराधियों के आपराधिक मामलों की सुनवाई का अधिकार देना
भारतीय भाषा के समाचार-पत्रों पर प्रतिबंध
कपास पर आयात शुल्क में कमी
questions.explanation: During Viceroy Ripon's time, the bill proposed to let Indian judges try Europeans and met strong European opposition. The Vernacular Press Act was 1878 and the partition of Bengal 1905.
questions.explanationHi: वायसराय रिपन के समय इस विधेयक में भारतीय न्यायाधीशों को यूरोपीयों के मुकदमे सुनने का अधिकार देने का प्रस्ताव था, जिसका यूरोपीयों ने कड़ा विरोध किया। वर्नाक्युलर प्रेस एक्ट 1878 और बंगाल विभाजन 1905 में हुआ।

questions.question: Black cotton soil (regur) is mainly formed by the weathering of:
questions.questionHi: काली कपास मिट्टी (रेगुर) मुख्यतः किसके अपक्षय से बनती है?
options: basaltic lava rocks of the Deccan Trap
optionsHi: हिमालयी नदियों द्वारा लाई गई जलोढ़ मिट्टी
दक्कन ट्रैप की बेसाल्ट लावा चट्टानें
questions.explanation: Regur develops from Deccan Trap basalt, is rich in clay and retains moisture, so it suits cotton. Alluvium forms the northern plains.
questions.explanationHi: रेगुर दक्कन ट्रैप के बेसाल्ट से बनती है, इसमें चिकनी मिट्टी अधिक होती है और नमी बनाए रखती है, इसलिए कपास के लिए उपयुक्त है। जलोढ़ मिट्टी उत्तरी मैदानों में बनती है।

questions.question: The blue colour of the clear daytime sky is mainly due to:
questions.questionHi: दिन के साफ़ आकाश का नीला रंग मुख्यतः किस कारण होता है?
options: absorption of blue light by ozone
Rayleigh scattering of sunlight by air molecules
optionsHi: ओज़ोन द्वारा नीले प्रकाश का अवशोषण
वायु के अणुओं द्वारा सूर्य-प्रकाश का रेले प्रकीर्णन
questions.explanation: Shorter (blue) wavelengths are scattered much more strongly by air molecules (Rayleigh scattering), so blue light reaches the eye from all directions.
questions.explanationHi: छोटी तरंगदैर्ध्य (नीला) का वायु-अणुओं द्वारा अधिक प्रकीर्णन होता है (रेले प्रकीर्णन), इसलिए नीला प्रकाश सभी दिशाओं से आँख तक पहुँचता है।

questions.question: Indravati National Park (Tiger Reserve) is located in which district of Chhattisgarh?
questions.questionHi: इंद्रावती राष्ट्रीय उद्यान (टाइगर रिज़र्व) छत्तीसगढ़ के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Indravati National Park lies in Bijapur district of the Bastar region, named after the Indravati river that forms part of its boundary.
questions.explanationHi: इंद्रावती राष्ट्रीय उद्यान बस्तर क्षेत्र के बीजापुर जिले में है; इसका नाम इंद्रावती नदी पर पड़ा है, जो इसकी सीमा का भाग बनाती है।
